login.title: Login
login.metadataDescription: Log in to your VdoHide account.
login.closedDescription: Login is temporarily closed. Please try again later.

register.title: Register
register.description: Create an account to get started
register.closedDescription: Registration is temporarily closed. Please try again later.
register.closedFollowDescription: Registration is temporarily closed. Follow the channel below and we will announce when it reopens.
register.success: Registration successful. Please verify your email.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email to receive a password reset link
forgotPassword.closedDescription: Forgot password is temporarily closed. Please try again later.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists with this email, you will receive a password reset link shortly.

setPassword.title: Set New Password
setPassword.invalidDescription: The token provided is invalid or has expired. Please request a new password reset link.
setPassword.success: Password has been reset successfully. You can now login.

verifyEmail.title: Verify Email
verifyEmail.verificationSent: We have sent a verification link to your email. Please check your inbox and click the link to verify your account.
verifyEmail.resetSent: We have sent a password reset link to your email. Please check your inbox and click the link to reset your password.
verifyEmail.verifyingDescription: Please wait while we confirm your verification link.
verifyEmail.verifiedDescription: Your email has been verified successfully. You can now sign in.
verifyEmail.verifiedAccountDescription: Your email has been verified successfully. You can now start using your account.
verifyEmail.invalidDescription: This verification link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
verifyEmail.resendSuccess: Verification email sent. Please check your inbox.
verifyEmail.resendError: Failed to send verification email. Please try again.

magicLink.verifyingDescription: Verifying your magic link. This will only take a moment.
magicLink.invalidDescription: This magic link is no longer valid. Magic links can only be used once and expire after a short time.

error.title: Authentication Error
error.description: An error occurred during authentication. Please try again.
error.accountNotLinkedDescription: This social account is not linked to any existing account. Please login with your email and password first, then link your social account from settings.
error.signupDisabledDescription: New account registration is currently disabled. Please contact the administrator for access.
error.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have permission to access this resource. Please contact the administrator.
